exclusions.source_text: Have an eastern cooperative oncology group (ECOG) performance status of 0 to 1

Any of the following within 3 months prior to enrollment/randomization: severe or unstable angina, myocardial infarction, clinically significant ventricular arrhythmias or heart failure New York heart association functional classification class III to IV
exclusions.threshold: within 3 months; NYHA class III to IV

exclusions.source_text: Another concurrent or prior primary malignancy within the last 36 months at informed consent
